blocks.text: Filipino-American stunt choreographer Jon Valera helped bring the signature moves of the popular video game franchise “Street Fighter” to the big screen. Directed by Kitao Sakurai, the upcoming action film features choreography inspired by the characters’ distinct fighting techniques, with Valera and his international stunt team working alongside the visual effects and special effects departments to re-create the franchise’s iconic moves. “There was a lot of pressure behind this movie,” Valera said in a statement sent to Inquirer Entertainment.
